data.name: Corneliana
data.short_meaning: Vine grower, horn of the moon
data.long_meaning: The name Corneliana is derived from the Latin word cornu, meaning 'horn'. The suffix -eliana indicates a female form. In Roman mythology, the moon goddess was depicted as having horns. Corneliana is a name that evokes the strength and nurturing qualities of the moon, as well as the idea of growth and fertility associated with vineyards.
